stories.title: Nasdaq leads Wall Street gains as SpaceX, Super Micro lift AI sentiment
stories.summary: The Nasdaq outperformed the broader market as AI-linked names including SpaceX and Super Micro Computer drove gains. The move lifted overall Wall Street sentiment in the session.
stories.whyItMatters: AI-linked names continue to set the tone for the broader market, so sentiment swings in a few stocks can move the whole index.
whatToWatch: Whether AI-driven gains spread to the S&P 500 and Dow
Follow-through from Super Micro and other AI hardware names in coming sessions
questions: How concentrated is this gain in just a few AI names?
Is this a durable rally or a single-day move?

sources.title: Nasdaq leads Wall Street gains as SpaceX, Super Micro boost AI sentiment

stories.title: Norfolk Southern declares $1.35 quarterly dividend
stories.summary: Norfolk Southern's board declared a quarterly dividend of $1.35 per share. The announcement is a routine capital-return update from the railroad operator.
stories.whyItMatters: Dividend declarations signal management's confidence in cash flow, a baseline data point for rail-sector income investors.
whatToWatch: Record and payment dates for the dividend
Norfolk Southern's next earnings report for any change in capital-return policy
questions: Is this dividend flat, raised, or cut versus the prior quarter?

stories.title: Comcast planning significant job cuts, Bloomberg reports
stories.summary: Comcast is planning significant layoffs, according to a Bloomberg News report. The scale, timing, and affected divisions were not detailed in the report.
stories.whyItMatters: Job cuts at a major media and telecom company can signal cost pressure in the sector and affect investor sentiment toward the stock.
whatToWatch: Official confirmation from Comcast on the scope of the cuts
questions: How many jobs are affected, and in which units?
What is driving the cost-cutting push?

stories.title: Cognizant to acquire SAP partner DyFlex Solutions
stories.summary: Cognizant has agreed to acquire DyFlex Solutions, a partner specializing in SAP consulting and implementation. The report did not disclose deal terms.
stories.whyItMatters: The deal adds to Cognizant's enterprise software consulting capabilities, a growth area as companies modernize their SAP systems.
whatToWatch: Deal terms and expected closing date
How DyFlex's SAP practice is integrated into Cognizant's consulting business
questions: How large is DyFlex, and what capability does it add?

stories.title: High oil prices ripple from groceries to home loans
stories.summary: Elevated oil prices are feeding through to everyday costs, from grocery bills to home-loan rates, according to a report on the broader economic impact of current price levels.
stories.whyItMatters: Oil is a cost input across the economy, so sustained high prices add to inflation pressure and complicate the interest-rate outlook.
whatToWatch: Whether oil prices stay elevated or ease in coming weeks
Upcoming inflation data for signs of oil cost pass-through
questions: What is driving oil prices higher right now?
How much further could this feed into headline inflation?

stories.title: AstraZeneca wins FDA approval for rare kidney disease drug
stories.summary: AstraZeneca said the U.S. FDA approved its treatment for a rare kidney disease. The approval adds a new product to the company's specialty drug portfolio.
stories.whyItMatters: A new FDA approval expands AstraZeneca's revenue pipeline and reinforces its position in rare-disease treatments.
whatToWatch: Launch timing and pricing for the new drug
Sales uptake in AstraZeneca's upcoming earnings reports
questions: Which specific kidney disease does the drug target?
How large is the addressable patient population?

stories.title: US orders diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia amid Houthi strikes
stories.summary: The United States ordered diplomatic staff to depart Saudi Arabia, citing Houthi strikes in the region. The move adds to geopolitical tension in a key oil-producing area.
stories.whyItMatters: Escalation near major oil infrastructure raises supply-risk concerns, a factor markets watch closely for its effect on crude prices.
whatToWatch: Further U.S. State Department guidance on personnel in the region
Any disruption to Saudi oil production or exports
Crude oil price reaction in coming sessions
questions: What specifically triggered the evacuation order?
Is there a direct threat to oil infrastructure?

stories.title: Kinder Morgan to invest $4.7 billion in two gas pipeline projects
stories.summary: Kinder Morgan announced a $4.7 billion investment in two natural gas pipeline projects, citing surging demand. The projects mark a major capital commitment for the energy infrastructure company.
stories.whyItMatters: The investment signals confidence in long-term natural gas demand growth, tied to power generation and data-center buildout.
whatToWatch: Construction timelines and in-service dates for both projects
Kinder Morgan's financing plans for the $4.7 billion outlay
questions: What is driving the demand surge behind these projects?
Which regions or customers will the pipelines serve?

sources.title: Kinder Morgan to invest $4.7 billion in two gas pipeline projects as demand surges

stories.title: Fortescue warns of operations hit as China state buyer talks drag on
stories.summary: Australia's Fortescue warned that unresolved talks with a Chinese state buyer could affect its operations. The iron ore producer flagged the risk as negotiations continue.
stories.whyItMatters: Fortescue is a major iron ore exporter, and friction with Chinese buyers can ripple through global iron ore prices and mining-sector sentiment.
whatToWatch: Outcome of the talks with the Chinese state buyer
Any further Fortescue statement on operational impact
questions: Which state buyer is involved, and what is the dispute about?
How material is the potential hit to Fortescue's operations?

sources.title: Australia’s Fortescue warns of operations hit as China state buyer talks rumble on
